_still_suspended.thin_extent: RESOLVED (E12 Ruling 25c, 2026-08-07): 0.005 GLOBAL, ruled at the stroke-lane ruling with the forbidden-set ladder in the room - see tools.texpass_iter.thin-extent for the value and its full grounds. The deferral held from Ruling 7c to the stroke-lane ruling exactly as pre-registered. HISTORICAL: CURVE MEASURED AND BANKED (handoff 2 Task 2.3); VALUE DELIBERATELY STILL UNDECIDED - E12 Ruling 7. The curve: at this subject's ruled framing one emit px = 6.718107e-04 canonical units, so the ship's 0.01 is 14.9 px and the character's 0.03 is 44.7 px; 0.01 withholds 15.304% of the visible figure / 26.819% of the wing region, 0.03 withholds 33.863% / 60.418%; knee between 0.005 and 0.0075.
